# HMB, NEXIS and ProMob-ICU: source relationships and interpretation limits

**HMB, NEXIS ve ProMob-ICU: kaynak ilişkileri ve yorum sınırları**

**Review dates:** HMB/NEXIS: 25 October 2026; ProMob-ICU addition: 26 October 2026 · Europe/Istanbul

**Scope:** Focused verification of original reports, study families and official registry metadata. This is not a completed systematic review, historical registry comparison or formal RoB 2/GRADE assessment. No VETİS session was used for this review.

Publication year, recruitment year and a new randomization are different facts. Related reports must retain their own outcomes and analysis populations without adding overlapping participants together. A registry link verifies study identity; it does not establish every final method or prespecified analysis.

**Türkçe kullanım notu:** Bir makalenin 2026'da yayımlanması, hastaların 2026'da randomize edildiği anlamına gelmez. Metabolik veya biyokimyasal bulgular tek başına anabolizma tanısına, klinik yarara veya takviye dozu seçimine çevrilmez.

## 1. Verified study relationships

| Publication record | Study family and registry | Interpretation of the relationship |
|---|---|---|
| `berger-hmb-metabolic-posthoc-2026` | Lausanne **HMB-ICU-CH**, [NCT03628365](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03628365) | Secondary post hoc biochemical report. Its Methods identify the parent population reported by Viana in 2021. It is not a new randomization. |
| `wu-icu-hmb-2025` | Fujian exercise/HMB trial, **ChiCTR2200057685** | A separate factorial trial family. The 2025 report includes 112 participants from the earlier 2023 report within its 266-person cohort. |
| `nexis-aa-cycling-2026` | **NEXIS**, [NCT03021902](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03021902) | Parent phase 2 randomized trial report of a combined amino-acid and cycling intervention. Its protocol and results are documents from one family, not separate trials. |
| `veldsman-icu-aa-mobilization-print-2026` | **ProMob-ICU**, [NCT04099108](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04099108) | Separate combined-strategy randomization from NEXIS. 53 randomized / 50 modified ITT; a linked same-cohort energy report is not another independent sample. |

The HMB linkage is explicit in indexed publisher Methods accompanying the [original Berger report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42202485/), and independently corroborated by the [official registry API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT03628365). Wu's overlap is explicitly stated in the [original 2025 Methods](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13054-025-05660-9). The [original NEXIS abstract](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42438140/) identifies its registration, corroborated by the [official NEXIS registry API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT03021902). Registry reference lists can contain background papers as well as derived reports; their labels alone do not prove participant overlap.

## 2. HMB: biochemical findings and two distinct trial families

### Lausanne HMB-ICU-CH

Berger's report, DOI **10.1016/j.clnu.2026.106690**, PMID **42202485**, appeared online on **16 May 2026**, in the July 2026 issue. The indexed [publisher Methods, section 2 and reference 7](https://www.clinicalnutritionjournal.com/article/S0261-5614%2826%2900117-2/fulltext) identify the Lausanne trial and the earlier Viana report, DOI **10.1016/j.clnu.2021.07.018**. They describe recruitment in 2018–2019 and stored-plasma analyses in 2021–early 2023. Direct full-text requests returned 403; access was to the original abstract and indexed original Methods/Article Info/Discussion, not the complete paper and tables.

The reported UCR comparison **125 versus 181, p = .002**, is an exploratory biochemical contrast. The indexed Discussion describes a smaller increase in the HMB group; it does not verify an absolute fall within individual patients. The **analyte and unit basis remain unverified**, as do the complete contrast definition, measurement windows and per-analyte denominators. These numbers must not be equated with the app's urea/creatinine ratio using mg/dL for both concentrations, or its separately labelled BUN/creatinine ratio. No conversion, threshold, anti-inflammatory benefit or anabolic-state classification is inferred.

The [2021 original report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34358832/) distinguishes **37 enrolled** from **30 completing day-15 tests**. Its primary muscle-area endpoint did not differ between groups. The later report's 37 included participants do not create a further independent cohort. The current registry identifies thigh muscle area between days 4 and 15 as the primary outcome and tracer-based protein synthesis/breakdown as secondary. A standalone full protocol or SAP was not retrieved; **CER-2018-00556** is a study/ethics identifier, not a verified protocol-publication DOI.

### Fujian exercise/HMB family

Wu's [2025 original paper](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13054-025-05660-9), DOI **10.1186/s13054-025-05660-9**, describes **10 ICUs in 5 hospitals** and includes the 112 participants from the [2023 original report](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13054-023-04698-x) within the expanded 266-person cohort. Both identify **ChiCTR2200057685**. They must not be counted as 112 plus 266 independent patients or merged with the Lausanne family.

The [indexed official ChiCTR version record](https://www.chictr.org.cn/hvshowproject.html?id=202250&v=1.1) confirms the identifier and registration date, **15 March 2022**. Direct registry opening returned 405; historical versions and the complete protocol/amendment chronology were not appraised. The intervention includes a separate exercise factor: exercise findings cannot be attributed to HMB, and absence of a detected interaction is not proof of equivalence.

**Türkçe:** Lausanne metabolizma çalışması ile Fujian egzersiz/HMB çalışması farklı ailelerdir. Wu'nun 2023 ve 2025 raporlarında bildirilen 112 kişilik örtüşme korunur. Berger'in UCR değerlerinin analiti ve birimi doğrulanmadan uygulamadaki oranlarla karşılaştırma veya dönüşüm yapılmaz; sonuç “anabolik” etiketi ya da otomatik HMB önerisi üretmez.

## 3. NEXIS: combined intervention and applicability

NEXIS results, DOI **10.1093/ajrccm/aamag287**, PMID **42438140**, appeared online on **13 July 2026**. The [original abstract](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42438140/) reports **115 randomized participants**. The intervention combines intravenous amino acids and cycling; its comparison does not isolate the amino-acid effect. The existing outcome uncertainty is retained: these methods do not establish equivalence, an optimal dose or a validated individual metabolic classifier.

The protocol is DOI **10.1136/bmjopen-2018-027893**, PMID **31371287**, published in 2019. [Indexed original publisher passages](https://bmjopen.bmj.com/content/9/7/e027893) describe individual 1:1 allocation, stratification by site and pre-randomization hospital stay, concealed central randomization and blinded outcome assessors. Direct publisher HTML/PDF returned 403; direct PMC reached a browser check. Access is **indexed original protocol passages**, not complete full-text review. The protocol plans **142 randomized participants**; the results abstract describes **128 evaluable participants planned**. These are different denominators, whose relationship was not independently reconciled from the full sample-size section.

Current registry eligibility describes early mechanically ventilated acute respiratory failure and pre-illness independent ambulation. Its exclusions include a primary systemic neuromuscular disease, an intracranial/spinal process affecting motor function, airway-protection-only intubation and AKI without renal replacement therapy. These are **current registry criteria**, not verified counts or exclusions in the final 2026 analysis population. They should prompt review of applicability to neurological immobility, dysphagia-related admission and renal subgroups; they must not automatically become app eligibility or treatment rules. [Official current registry](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03021902).

**Türkçe:** NEXIS, aminoasit ile bisiklet egzersizini birlikte değerlendirir; aminoasidin bağımsız etkisini göstermez. Güncel kayıt sayfasındaki nörolojik ve AKI dışlama ölçütleri, son makalenin gerçek hasta akışı doğrulanmadan nihai kohorta mal edilmez. Tam sonuç yöntemleri ve ekleriyle uygunluk incelemesi hâlâ gereklidir.

## 4. Public registry chronology: current records, not archived versions

| Event / field | HMB-ICU-CH — NCT03628365 | NEXIS — NCT03021902 |
|---|---|---|
| First submitted | 7 August 2018 | 21 December 2016 |
| First publicly posted | 14 August 2018 | 16 January 2017; API date type `ESTIMATED`. |
| Actual start | 17 September 2018 | 28 September 2017 |
| Actual primary completion | 6 January 2020 | 14 January 2025 |
| Actual study completion | 6 January 2020 | 23 June 2025 |
| Last update publicly posted | 21 August 2020 | 27 August 2025 |
| Actual enrollment | 37 | 115 |
| Primary outcome in current record | Thigh muscle area, change from day 4 to day 15. | Six-minute walk distance at hospital discharge, up to 26 weeks after randomization. |
| Protocol/SAP document section | Absent from retrieved API response. | Absent from retrieved API response. |

Sources: [official HMB API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT03628365), [official NEXIS API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT03021902), read through normal public requests. Missing document sections do not prove that a protocol or SAP does not exist. Registration chronology precedes the recorded starts; current fields do not establish the original wording or timing of every eventual analysis and amendment.

The 2021 HMB publisher Methods give a study interval beginning **15 September 2018**, while the current registry gives **17 September 2018**. Both provenances remain recorded; an explanation was not verified. The indexed HMB registry history listed version dates, but the individual versions were not compared. No complete historical registry comparison was performed for NEXIS.

## 5. Access and verification limits

| Material | Access achieved on 25 October 2026 | Remaining limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Berger 2026 and Viana 2021 | Original abstracts and indexed original publisher passages. | Complete papers, tables and per-analyte populations not reviewed. |
| Wu 2023 and 2025 | Original publisher full text; relevant family/methods passages read. | Full protocol and extension amendments not appraised. |
| ChiCTR record | Indexed official version page. | Direct opening 405; no historical comparison. |
| NEXIS results | Original indexed abstract; registry corroboration. | Full result methods and supplements not reviewed. |
| NEXIS protocol | Indexed original publisher passages. | Direct HTML/PDF 403 and PMC browser check; no complete-reading claim. |
| HMB and NEXIS registries | Official current public API JSON. | Current records do not replace archived versions or final SAPs. |

No verified correction was identified in these focused searches; this does not establish that no correction exists. UCR units/contrast details, cytokine multiplicity, missing/deceased outcome handling, final analysis populations and amendment timelines remain for original-document review. No formal bias grade or new safety/efficacy conclusion was assigned from biomarkers.

## 7. ProMob-ICU: combined strategy and selected analysis population

**26 October 2026 addition.** The [original Veldsman report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12865756/), DOI [10.1002/jpen.70041](https://doi.org/10.1002/jpen.70041), explicitly names **ProMob-ICU / NCT04099108**. Online publication was 31 December 2025; the issue is February 2026. This single-centre Cape Town surgical ICU trial is distinct from NEXIS. Its predominantly young, male surgical/trauma population does not establish applicability to an unselected neurological or medical ICU cohort.

The main Results report **649 screened → 71 eligible/approached → 53 randomized → 50 modified ITT (25/25)**. Two early deaths and one consent withdrawal occurred before primary measurements. Their original arm assignments are unverified; final 25/25 does not establish initial randomized arm sizes. The registry's 50 actual enrollment is a separate provenance, not a replacement for 53 randomized. Biopsy, ultrasound and secondary model-specific contributor counts remain unknown; 50 mITT does not establish 50 paired biopsies. The unread flow image is not reconstructed from subtraction.

Both groups received targeted nutrition and routine mobilization. The added intervention combined a four-hour central-IV amino-acid infusion with 45 minutes of cycling, beginning 72–96 hours after admission and ending by day 10. Passive/active cycling depended on status; amino acids could still be delivered when cycling was withheld. This is a combined strategy over active standard care, not isolated amino-acid, cycling or leucine efficacy. Trial-specific achieved intake is not an individualized dose recommendation.

Co-primary changes were vastus-lateralis myofiber area by biopsy and rectus-femoris area by ultrasound, before intervention on average day 2 and after five intervention days on average day 8. These are average observation times. Table 2 group×time P values are 0.91/0.70; arm/time mean confidence intervals are not treatment-effect intervals. Within-group biochemical change does not establish between-group benefit, net anabolism or equivalence. Conflicting primary-alpha assignments and secondary-multiplicity descriptions remain unresolved without the dated protocol/SAP.

The [current official API](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT04099108) was read; the [human-facing registry](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04099108) is a navigation link. Public posting **23 September 2019** preceded recorded actual start **24 May 2021**. Last update posted **3 December 2025** does not establish when final analyses were specified. Current primaries are two pre/post muscle measures; the three-timepoint plasma-amino-acid measure is secondary and intervention-only. Main Methods/Results, HTML tables and Discussion were reviewed; **S1 protocol, S2–S4 supplement, SAP, figure images and archived history remain unread**.

Discussion/reference 48 and the registry identify an [earlier same-cohort energy-expenditure report](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clnesp.2024.11.009), online November 2024 / issue 2025. Its original text was not opened; exact participant overlap remains unknown. It adds no independent participants here. No formal bias grade or metabolic classifier follows.

**Türkçe:** ProMob-ICU, NEXIS'ten ayrı tek merkezli bir deneydir. 53 kişi randomize edilmiş, 50 kişi modifiye ITT'de 25/25 analiz edilmiştir; iki erken ölüm ve bir çekilmenin kol dağılımı bilinmiyor. Her iki grup rutin mobilizasyon alır; ek IV aminoasit ve bisiklet birleşik müdahaledir. Sonuca özgü kişi sayıları ve şekil akışı yeniden kurulmaz. Kayıt başlangıçtan önce kamuya açıktır; son analiz önbelirlenimi, S1 protokolü ve ekler doğrulanmadı. Aynı kohortun önceki enerji raporu okunmadı, bağımsız örneklem sayılmaz. İzole aminoasit yararı veya otomatik doz sonucu çıkarılmaz.
